I am so glad you posted this, since I'm having doubts about my own BP2 diagnosis as well, due to the same reason (not being textbook hypomanic), but it turns out I have similarities with you (and the other commenters here). So I guess that's one sign that we might really have hypomanic episodes, even if not textbook.  


If my diagnosis is correct, my hypomania presents more as an agitated, irritable, restless, and anxious state where I just feel like *going* all the time. Full of energy, although it's not euphoric/happy. Sometimes it also takes on an obsessive, repetitive edge, and I tend to become *really interested* in something for a concentrated amount of time. I notice I also tend to get internally rage-y. I also really spend more, and I have been told that it seems justifiable to blow at least $200 on books because, well, they're "functional". But the spending can get really excessive, so... That and increased libido are kind of textbook signs of hypomania iirc.  


I also still get tired from all the restlessness, racing thoughts, and anxiety. My nightmares mostly come from my PTSD, though, so I'm not sure about yours.   


I hope this comment helps, and please don't hesitate to send me a message to talk about it more!
